name: io.github.shariqriazz/google-ai-search-mcp
title: Google AI Search MCP
description: Google AI search and documentation tools for MCP clients using Vertex AI or the Gemini API.

environmentVariables.name: AI_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Select vertex or gemini. Defaults to vertex.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Google Cloud project ID. Required when AI_PROVIDER is vertex.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION
environmentVariables.description: Vertex AI location. Defaults to us-central1.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Gemini API key. Required when AI_PROVIDER is gemini.
